objective: Bring the Inert Scourgestone to Commander Ashlan Valorfist in Chillwind Point.

description: The evil has been purged from the stones, <name>.
I am aware of Commander Ashlam's plans, and he will require only a single inert stone.  Bring it to him so we may bathe the Scourge in righteous fire.
progress: Was Thal'danis able to cleanse the scourgestones?
completion: You have done as I asked without question, <name>.
Trust is achieved, it seems. Perhaps I can reveal our plan in more detail to you now.
